external_observations.evidence_span: Blåhammer Camping Google profile: rating 4.6/5, 370 ratings.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: cozy cabin with everything you need + good WiFi (no pots and cutlery), very friendly owners, very nice & clean bathrooms. dogs allowed. we planed to stayed for 2 nights and ended up staying 5 because it was so nice there.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: An excellent campsite, especially as campsites feel few and far between around this coastline. A welcome break from wild camping/mountain hut. Although lacking in quantity the showers and other facilities were always spotlessly clean. The kind owners froze our blocks in their personal freezer for us. Beautiful surroundings & we could pitch our small tent anywhere. Lots of picnic benches on the front to sit and eat, even if you don’t have a ‘front row’ spot. 10/10 would recommend.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Great value cabin with pretty much everything you need! The room is clean and heated. You can bring your own bedsheets or pay just a little bit to use theirs. There is a nice common shower and kitchen facility. The surrounding area is also great to walk around.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: What a gorgeous find. Parked our motorhome right at the front by the little beach. Greeted with a lovely smiling face. Immaculate sanitary facilities and the shower powerful and hot. Very surprised to have free WiFi too. Shame we could only stay one night as we would have loved to hire a boat for a bit of fishing as the weather wasn't ideal when we arrived. Will definitely come back if we're in the area.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Excellent and welcoming familyrun small camping. One of the best I have come across in Norway. Pity hot water works with coins (keep finding that extremely strange) and there's only a single shower, very, very clean though. Nice facilities, all one needs.
